single.rationale: Arrowhead achieved a transformational milestone with FDA approval of REDEMPLO in 2025, transitioning from pure R&D to commercial operations with dramatic revenue expansion to $829M. The company now generates positive operating income and free cash flow while maintaining a deep pipeline of 18 clinical candidates and multiple Phase 3 programs targeting large addressable markets in severe hypertriglyceridemia and cardiovascular disease.
